Lina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — customers want a short snippet for GA timing on three items: model pinning + rollout UI, Optimize suggestions/export/apply, streaming + function-calls GA ETA. Can product confirm?

Noah: TL;DR: rollout UI beta late Aug (internal canary first week Aug), GA late Aug if canary passes; Optimize console suggestions preview mid-Sept, export/API and opt-in apply late Sept; streaming+function-calls expected GA feature-flag in ~5 weeks. Will publish RFC with hard dates after infra gating. :spiral_calendar:

Priya: Marketing note: don't include exact days in public blog — use month windows. For Dedicated customers we can offer early access invites. I'll draft a short blurb and a FAQ for CS.

Marco: Infra note: rollout UI depends on session-affinity fixes (ENG-2670). There's a flaky kube-proxy interaction that can push the canary by ~1 week. Quick repro command I used: ```kubectl -n infra exec deploy/kube-proxy -- curl -s localhost:8080/health | jq .sessions``` . Ping me if you need logs or access.

Lina: Can we also confirm SDK readiness for streaming+function-calls? Some partners asked about Python/JS examples.

Noah: SDKs status: JS streaming helper merged; Python SDK needs one docs/examples PR and will be ready in ~2 weeks. We'll include migration examples in the RFC and a short changelog entry.

Priya: Customer-ready one-liner for CS (pasteable): "Planned windows: rollout UI late August (beta first), Optimize suggestions preview in September with export and opt-in apply to follow, and streaming+function-calls reaching feature-flag GA in ~5 weeks. Exact GA dates will be shared after canary and QA."

Lina: Perfect. Noah — please tag CS/docs when the RFC lands so they can prep comms.
